full_prompt_en: A square editorial watercolor and ink illustration shows an older blond man in a dark suit sitting amid the rubble of a ruined building. He is placed left of center on a broken stone step, leaning forward with both hands close to one knee. A white shirt and long vivid red tie cut through the black jacket and trousers; polished black shoes rest on uneven fragments below. His face is drawn with a heavy expression, looking down and slightly to the right rather than toward the viewer. Behind him, a damaged wall rises across the right half of the picture, with exposed brick, cracked plaster, hanging wires, and a deep black opening near the upper right. To the left, a slanted heap of crushed wood, stone, and metal reaches toward a narrow strip of pale background. The ground is crowded with broken boards, dust, leaves, and small pieces of masonry, all rendered in tan, gray, ocher, and muted green. Bright neutral light enters from above the ruined wall, illuminating the blond hair, white shirt, and some pale debris, while heavy shadow fills the interior gaps. Fine dark linework defines jagged edges and facial features; transparent washes soften stone surfaces and paper white remains visible around the outside of the scene. A thin black rectangular border encloses the image within a broader white margin. The composition feels tense and weary, placing a carefully observed figure against a dense field of destruction without adding captions or signs.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形编辑水彩墨线插画描绘一名年长金发男子穿深色西装坐在毁坏建筑的碎瓦砾间。他位于中间偏左，坐在断裂石阶上，身体前倾，双手靠近一侧膝盖。白衬衫和鲜红长领带穿过黑色外套与长裤；擦亮的黑皮鞋踩在下方不平碎块上。他的脸带沉重表情，视线向下并略朝右，而非看向观者。身后，破损墙面升满右半画面，露出砖块、开裂灰泥、悬挂电线，右上附近还有一道深黑开口。左侧，压碎的木头、石块和金属倾斜堆起，指向一小条浅色背景。地面挤满断木、尘土、叶片和小碎石，颜色为浅褐、灰、赭黄和低饱和绿。明亮中性光从废墙上方进入，照亮金发、白衬衫和一些浅色碎屑，内部缝隙仍有重影。细深线界定锯齿边缘和面部特征；透明洗色柔化石面，场景外缘保留纸白。一道细黑矩形边框将图像围在更宽白色页边内。构图紧张而疲惫，把仔细观察的人物置于密集毁坏痕迹前，没有添加标题或标语。
style_prompt_en: Editorial watercolor and ink illustration combines close observational drawing with an uneven, heavily worked environment. Crisp dark contours define jagged fragments and a compact focal form, while translucent gray, tan, ocher, and muted green washes settle into broken textures. One narrow saturated red accent cuts through a mostly subdued earth palette. Paper white remains at selected outer edges, and a fine rectangular frame gives the composition a printed page quality. Dense angular marks collect around one side and recede into deep shadow; lighter open passages let the eye rest. Illumination arrives from high above, picking out pale raised planes and leaving irregular gaps nearly black. Central surfaces are modeled precisely while retaining the restless energy of ink scratches and watercolor blooms. The whole image feels pointed, weary, and tactile, using contrast between a concentrated center and disordered surroundings to carry its mood.
style_prompt_zh: 编辑水彩墨线插画把近距离观察式素描与不均匀、反复刻画的环境结合。清晰深轮廓界定锯齿碎片和紧凑视觉焦点，半透明灰、浅褐、赭黄与低饱和绿洗色沉入破碎肌理。一条狭窄饱和红色重音穿过大体低调的大地色域。选定外缘保留纸白，细矩形框赋予构图印刷纸页质感。密集棱角笔痕聚在一侧并退入深影，较浅开放通道让眼睛休息。光从高处进入，拣出浅色凸面，让不规则缝隙近乎全黑。中心表面被精确塑造，同时保留墨线刮痕与水彩晕开的躁动能量。整体尖锐、疲惫且可触，凭紧凑中心与无序周边的对比承载情绪。
theme_en: A suited blond man seated amid the ruins of a building
theme_zh: 一名穿西装的金发男子坐在建筑废墟中
name: Michael Ramirez
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
